steps: The radius drawn to the point of tangency is perpendicular to the tangent line.
That makes a right triangle with legs 5 (radius) and the tangent segment, and hypotenuse 13 (centre to external point).
By the Pythagorean theorem: tangent² = 13² − 5² = 144.
The tangent segment has length 12.
